
```{r}
library(TMB)
library(Matrix)
```

------------------------------------------------------------
1. Sum-to-zero basis for a factor
------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
sum_to_zero_basis <- function(K) {
  Q <- diag(K) - matrix(1 / K, K, K)
  qr.Q(qr(Q))[, 1:(K - 1), drop = FALSE]
}
```

------------------------------------------------------------
2. Kronecker basis for interactions
------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
interaction_basis <- function(B_list) {
  Reduce(kronecker, B_list)
}
```

------------------------------------------------------------
3. Build B for main effects + interactions
------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
build_B <- function(factors, max_order = length(factors)) {
  B_main <- lapply(factors, function(f) {
    sum_to_zero_basis(nlevels(f))
  })

  B_blocks <- list()

  for (order in seq_len(max_order)) {
    combos <- combn(seq_along(factors), order, simplify = FALSE)

    for (idx in combos) {
      name <- paste(names(factors)[idx], collapse = ":")
      B_blocks[[name]] <- interaction_basis(B_main[idx])
    }
  }

  bdiag(B_blocks)
}
```

------------------------------------------------------------
4. Build design matrix X (NO intercept)
------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
build_X <- function(data, terms) {
  X_blocks <- lapply(terms, function(fml) {
    model.matrix(as.formula(paste0("~ ", fml, " - 1")), data)
  })

  do.call(cbind, X_blocks)
}
```

Example terms:

```{r}
terms <- c(
  "A",
  "B",
  "A:B"
)
```

------------------------------------------------------------
5. Example: contingency table setup
------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
I <- 30L
J <- 50L
D <- 1000L
vocab_I <- paste0("I_cat", 1:I)
vocab_J <- paste0("J_cat", 1:J)

N_total <- 10000L

get_powerlaw <- function(no_cats){
  prenorm = 1/(1:no_cats)
  prenorm / sum(prenorm)
}

set.seed(2025)
doc_idx <- sample(D, N_total, replace = TRUE) 
cats_slot1 <- sample(I, N_total, replace = TRUE, prob = get_powerlaw(I))
cats_slot2 <- sample(J, N_total, replace = TRUE, prob = get_powerlaw(J))
n_obs <- sample(c(1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L), N_total, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.4, 0.25, 0.15, 0.1, 0.1))
n_obs[1] <- 10L
n_obs[5] <- 20L
exposure_perdoc <- ceiling(runif(D, min = 30, max = 80)) 
exposures <- exposure_perdoc[doc_idx]
```

```{r}
reference_matrix <- function(f) {
  model.matrix(~ f - 1) # standard R reference coding with first level as reference
}

build_C <- function(f) {
  K <- nlevels(f)
  B <- sum_to_zero_basis(K)
  # Identity for first K-1 levels in B
  C <- rbind(diag(K-1), -1*matrix(1, 1, K-1)) # last row = -sum of others
  return(C)
}

interaction_basis <- function(B_list) Reduce(kronecker, B_list)
interaction_mapping <- function(C_list) Reduce(kronecker, C_list)

```

```{r}
build_BC <- function(factors, max_order = length(factors)) {
  B_blocks <- list()
  C_blocks <- list()
  
  # Main effects
  B_main <- lapply(factors, function(f) sum_to_zero_basis(nlevels(f)))
  C_main <- lapply(factors, function(f) build_C(f))
  
  for(order in seq_len(max_order)) {
    combos <- combn(seq_along(factors), order, simplify = FALSE)
    for(idx in combos) {
      name <- paste(names(factors)[idx], collapse=":")
      B_blocks[[name]] <- interaction_basis(B_main[idx])
      C_blocks[[name]] <- interaction_mapping(C_main[idx])
    }
  }
  
  B <- bdiag(B_blocks)
  C <- bdiag(C_blocks)
  
  list(B=B, C=C)
}

# 1f. Build likelihood design matrix X_ref (reference coding)
build_Xref <- function(data, terms) {
  X_blocks <- lapply(terms, function(fml) model.matrix(as.formula(paste0("~", fml, "-1")), data))
  do.call(cbind, X_blocks)
}

```

```{r}
# Data frame with factors and counts
dat <- data.frame(
  y = n_obs,
  A = factor(cats_slot1),
  B = factor(cats_slot2)
)

# Offset: expected counts or exposure
offset <- log(exposures)

# Factors list
factors <- list(A = dat$A, B = dat$B)

# Build matrices
X <- build_X(dat, terms = c("A", "B", "A:B"))
B <- build_B(factors, max_order = 2)

stopifnot(ncol(X) == nrow(B))
```

------------------------------------------------------------
6. Compile and fit model
------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
dat <- data.frame(
  y = c(5,2,3,7,1,4),
  A = factor(c("a1","a2","a1","a2","a1","a2")),
  B = factor(c("b1","b1","b2","b2","b1","b2"))
)
offset <- rep(0, nrow(dat))

factors <- list(A=dat$A, B=dat$B)
terms <- c("A","B","A:B")

# Build B and C
BC <- build_BC(factors, max_order=2)
B <- BC$B
C <- BC$C

# Reference coding design matrix
X_ref <- build_Xref(dat, terms)

# Data list for TMB
data <- list(
  y = dat$y,
  offset = offset,
  X_ref = X_ref,
  B = B,
  C = C,
  lambda = 0.1
)

parameters <- list(
  intercept = 0,
  alpha = rep(0, ncol(B)),
  log_phi = 0
)

```

```{r}
library(here)
compile(here("cpp", "nb_lasso_stz_intercept.cpp"), clean = TRUE)
dyn.load(dynlib(here("cpp", "nb_lasso_stz_intercept")))

obj <- MakeADFun(
  data = data,
  parameters = parameters,
  DLL = "nb_lasso_stz_intercept",
  silent = TRUE
)

opt <- nlminb(obj$par, obj$fn, obj$gr)
```

------------------------------------------------------------
7. Extract fitted parameters
------------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
par <- opt$par

intercept_hat <- par["intercept"]
phi_hat <- exp(par["log_phi"])

alpha_hat <- par[grep("^alpha", names(par))]
beta_hat  <- as.vector(B %*% alpha_hat)

eta_hat <- intercept_hat + X %*% beta_hat + offset
mu_hat  <- exp(eta_hat)
```
